data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 4.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Deteriorations of GBP 2.0 million on third party liability, GBP 2.8 million on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 3.4 million on fire and other damage to property were partially offset by improvements of GBP 2.2 million on energy and GBP 1.8 million on reinsurance acceptances.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 Syndicate 2121 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 327.578m and experienced an overall deterioration on prior years' provisions of GBP 4.1m (c. 1.25% of opening gross reserves). The adverse movement was driven by deterioration in Casualty (third party liability), Marine and Property (fire and other damage to property), partially offset by favourable development in Energy and in reinsurance acceptances.
raw_causal_phrases: An overall deterioration of GBP 4.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year.

Deteriorations of GBP 2.0 million on third party liability, GBP 2.8 million on marine, aviation and transport and GBP 3.4 million on fire and other damage to property were partially offset by improvements of GBP 2.2 million on energy and GBP 1.8 million on reinsurance acceptances.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement taken from Note 3 narrative ('An overall deterioration of GBP 4.1 million...'). The note gives the aggregate movement and LOB breakdown amounts explicitly but does not label them as 'gross' or 'net' in the short narrative; we have treated these as gross prior years' provision movements (confidence 0.8). A detailed gross movement table with separate 'Insurance liabilities' column was not present in an explicit single-line movement table, so the narrative was used. Claims development triangle exists in the Technical Provisions note (page 53) but parsing of the triangle into fully aligned per-year development rows in the PDF text is ambiguous due to the 'Before 2011' aggregated column placement; therefore the triangle was not converted into full numeric rows here.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the Technical Provisions note (shows cumulative claims and payments by underwriting year). Extraction of every development-period row aligned to the individual UW year columns was ambiguous in the OCR'd text because the table includes a 'Before 2011' aggregated column and several rows omit the most recent year values. The triangle type is therefore marked as 'gross' with page reference but detailed period rows were not included due to extraction ambiguity.
